{{Quote|A team lead by Dr. Ils Ee apparently acquired a device called the Sharka'k Noor.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>}}
'''Ils Ee''' was an individual who held the degree of [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]<ref name="Files" /> around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Date">"[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," which mentions [[Realspace/Legends|space]] traffic control [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], is set "shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]" following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which is dated to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ils Ee was created for the article "[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in the [[August]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14]].<ref name="Files" />
